title: 中文海报
review: A有乱码及“不要二维码”等多余字；B的8项目标文案清楚、内容正确，未再印入限制语句。两版均为2048×2048，没有采用改写建议的2:3画幅。
originalPrompt:
设计一张竖版中文咖啡店开业海报，成熟的平面设计，奶油白纸张、深墨绿色大字、少量朱红色点缀，中央是一杯有拉花的拿铁与一枝桂花的精致商业静物摄影，四周留白充足，信息层级清楚。海报中必须包含且只能包含以下文字，每一行逐字准确：
桂花拿铁
把秋天，装进一杯里。
九月限定 · 每日现做
热饮 ¥28 / 冰饮 ¥30
2026.09.20—10.20
营业时间 08:30—21:00
南山路128号
第二杯半价，周末也算。
不要二维码，不要英文，不要品牌标志，不要额外小字。

In the upper-central area of the frame, a large, bold serif headline in deep ink-green reads "桂花拿铁", anchoring the top section with significant visual weight and traditional elegance. Directly beneath the main title, a smaller line of elegant serif text in the same deep ink-green hue states "把秋天，装进一杯里。", positioned centrally to establish the emotional narrative of the design. In the exact center of the composition sits a high-quality commercial still life photograph of a ceramic latte cup containing artful foam swirls, accompanied by a delicate branch of golden osmanthus flowers resting nearby on the surface. To the right of the central cup, a small, precise vermilion dot or dash serves as a subtle accent, adding a touch of contrast to the dominant green and cream palette without overwhelming the minimalist aesthetic. Below the central image, in the middle-lower section, a line of medium-weight sans-serif text in deep ink-green reads "九月限定 · 每日现做", providing clear temporal context for the offer. Further down in the lower-third of the frame, a price list line in smaller, clean sans-serif font displays "热饮 ¥28 / 冰饮 ¥30", maintaining strict alignment with the center axis. Below the pricing information, the date range is presented as "2026.09.20—10.20" in a compact, legible sans-serif typeface, ensuring clarity for the promotional period. Near the bottom edge, above the footer area, the operating hours are listed as "营业时间 08:30—21:00" in a restrained deep ink-green sans-serif font. At the very bottom of the frame, centered horizontally, the address line reads "南山路128号" in small, precise characters. Finally, the last line of text at the base of the poster reads "第二杯半价，周末也算。", completing the informational hierarchy with a friendly call to action. The lighting is soft and diffused, casting gentle shadows beneath the cup and flowers to ground them in the space, while the paper texture remains uniformly lit to emphasize the print quality. The overall composition uses a balanced, centered vertical grid with generous white space, creating a calm, autumnal mood that feels both premium and inviting.

title: 面包师首图
review: A右侧一只脚被画框裁切；B双脚完整入镜，一脚踩凳、另一腿向下。B的人物外观和朝向发生变化；这是无参考图的文生图比较，不是同一人物保持测试。
originalPrompt: Create ONLY ONE 9:16 photorealistic vintage baker portrait, a single full-body photograph with a soft, intimate POV feeling. A beautiful adult East Asian woman with realistic skin texture, soft natural hair and a sensual but natural presence wears a simple ivory backless summer dress, a light apron and a delicate cream headscarf. She sits sideways on a dark walnut kitchen countertop, one long leg extended diagonally downward and the other foot resting naturally on a small wooden stool. Both legs and feet are fully visible, with believable anatomy and contact with the furniture. Her shoulders turn gently toward the nearby viewer; her chin is slightly lowered, eyes lifted into direct eye contact, with a subtle playful smile. Frame from above the head to below both feet with comfortable margins. The refined retro Shaker kitchen has mushroom-gray cabinets, warm gray stone surfaces and subtle brass hardware. Use soft clean summer daylight, neutral to slightly warm colors, natural skin and ivory clothing. Let posture, shoulders, waistline, long legs and eye contact be the visual focus. Props stay small and secondary. The mood is feminine, playful, slightly flirty and editorial. One photograph only. No collage, grids, multiple panels, repeated figures, yellow filter, orange skin, oversized cookware, distorted hands, exaggerated wide-angle distortion, text or watermark.
rewrittenPrompt: The image is a vertical photorealistic vintage portrait of a beautiful adult East Asian woman seated in a refined retro Shaker kitchen, set against a background of mushroom-gray cabinets and warm gray stone surfaces with subtle brass hardware. She sits sideways on a dark walnut kitchen countertop that spans the lower middle of the frame, her body angled slightly away but with her shoulders turning gently toward the viewer to create an intimate point-of-view feel. Her head is positioned in the upper third, framed by a delicate cream headscarf tied softly over her natural hair, which falls in loose, realistic textures around her face and neck. Her chin is lowered slightly while her eyes lift into direct eye contact with the lens, her expression holding a subtle playful smile that conveys a sensual yet natural presence. She wears a simple ivory backless summer dress paired with a light apron, the fabric appearing soft and lightweight against her realistic skin texture, where the shoulder blades are visible due to the open back of the garment. Her left leg extends diagonally downward in front of her, fully visible from hip to foot, showcasing believable anatomy and a long line that leads the eye toward the lower edge. Her right foot rests naturally on a small wooden stool tucked beneath the counter, providing a grounded contact point with the furniture while keeping the posture relaxed and balanced. The dark walnut surface of the countertop shows visible wood grain, contrasting with the smoother, cooler tone of the stone backsplash behind her. Soft clean summer daylight enters from an unseen source on the left, casting gentle shadows to the right and highlighting the contours of her face, arms, and legs without harsh contrast. The lighting maintains neutral to slightly warm colors, preserving the natural skin tones and the creamy hue of her ivory dress. Small props remain secondary in the frame, including a few indistinct items on the counter that do not distract from the central figure. The background features clean lines and uncluttered shelving, emphasizing the refined aesthetic of the kitchen space. The framing extends from just above her head to below both feet, with comfortable margins ensuring nothing essential is cropped. The overall composition feels feminine, playful, and editorial, relying on the balance between her long legs, the curve of her waistline, and the direct engagement of her gaze.

title: 抬手取玻璃罐
review: A在关闭的柜门前举罐；B补出了打开的储物格，手握罐子与搁架的位置关系更符合取物要求。人物与厨房仍可辨认为同一系列，但局部场景细节有变化。
originalPrompt: Edit <image1> to create one new photorealistic portrait in the same vintage kitchen series. Keep exactly the same adult woman, facial identity, hairstyle, cream headscarf, ivory backless summer dress and light apron. She stands by the mushroom-gray upper cabinets and reaches one arm upward to take a small glass jar from an open shelf, while the other hand rests lightly on the dark walnut counter. Her body is in a graceful side view with the simple backless dress visible, but her face turns toward the camera with a playful side glance, chin slightly raised. Her raised hand actually grasps the jar; keep believable shoulder, elbow, wrist and fingers. Frame the raised hand, head, torso, legs and feet fully. Preserve the same neutral summer daylight, gray cabinets and natural photographic skin texture. One vertical photograph, no collage, no exaggerated wide-angle distortion, no text or watermark.

title: 反坐高脚椅
review: 两版都未清楚完成双前臂搭在椅背上的反坐姿态；B主要改变了椅子和身体位置，原姿势的约束仍然很强。
originalPrompt: Edit <image1> to create one new photorealistic portrait in the same vintage kitchen series. Keep exactly the same adult woman, facial identity, hairstyle, cream headscarf, ivory backless summer dress and light apron. Change her pose and the camera position: she sits backwards on a tall wooden chair with a low backrest, her forearms resting loosely along the top of the chair back. Turn the chair and her torso at an oblique angle so part of the simple open back of the dress is visible. She turns her head toward the close viewer with profile-based eye contact and a small knowing smile. The low chair back remains below her chest. Her hips rest on the seat, legs and feet are naturally positioned around the chair, one foot on its rung. Keep the whole seated pose and both feet in frame. Preserve the mushroom-gray Shaker cabinets, dark walnut, neutral summer daylight and natural photographic skin texture. One vertical photograph, no collage, no text or watermark.
rewrittenPrompt: 编辑<image1>，生成一张新的写实照片，延续同一组“复古厨房”系列。画面中必须是同一位成年女性，完全保留她的面部身份、五官与皮肤的真实摄影质感；保留她深棕微卷长发、头顶奶油色蝴蝶结头巾、象牙色露背吊带夏日连衣裙，以及身上轻盈的浅色围裙，这些服装与配饰与输入图完全一致。保持背景为同一厨房：蘑菇灰色 Shaker 橱柜、深色胡桃木中岛/吧台、浅色台面、窗边柔和的夏季自然光、绿植与厨房器物等环境元素均与输入图一致，光线方向与明暗基调不变。改变她的姿态与机位：她改为背对椅面坐在一张高脚木椅上（椅子为低靠背、无扶手、圆形木面、四腿带横枋），椅面高度较低，靠背顶缘大约在她的胸口下方；她双臂自然松弛地搭在椅背顶部，身体与椅子整体以斜侧角度朝向镜头，使连衣裙简单开放式后背的一部分可见；她的头转向靠近镜头的观察者，以近乎侧面的角度进行眼神接触，嘴角带一点含蓄、了然的微笑；臀部坐在椅面上，双腿与双脚自然垂落并分布在椅子周围，其中一只脚踩在椅腿横枋上，另一只脚自然落地或悬于地面附近，两只脚和整个坐姿都必须完整出现在画面内，不被裁切。机位为低机位、近距离、竖构图人像，主体居中偏右，前景为深色木椅与桌面边缘，景深自然，真实摄影感。输出为一张单一竖版照片，不做拼图，不加任何文字、水印或标识。
